kicker: Launch videos, read line by line

scenes.headline: How a launch video gets made from code
scenes.sub: A skill, its slim variant, and a music video, read line by line.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tarragon! Three repos went round as videos a model made in one shot. Here's what sits between prompt and frames.

scenes.text: Every video here is code that paints each frame from the time alone. One shot names the final run, not the template under it.
scenes.mark: paints each frame from the time alone
scenes.say: Every video here is code that paints each frame from the time alone. One shot names the final run, not what was built under it.

steps.say: Each one reads something first, a project's pages or a song, and writes a plan to a file.
Then the model writes code that paints any frame from the time alone.
A headless browser calls that code once per frame and saves each picture.
Frames and audio meet only at the very end, so sync is decided before the render.

scenes.title: What the brag skill makes the agent do
scenes.say: The brag skill is nearly fifteen hundred lines of instructions, in four gated steps.

items.say: Read the site: its main page, its colours, and the flow a user clicks through.
Write a plan whose scenes add up to fifteen to twenty-five seconds.
Hand an HTML video framework a brief, and pass its lint and contrast check.
Render, then paint the best frame over frame zero, the one every platform grabs.

scenes.title: How the music video keeps time

left.title: Estimated from line length
items: Letters fill at a fixed rate
left.say: The template it followed timed whole lines and guessed each word from the line's length.

right.title: Measured on the vocal
right.say: The music video split out the vocal, aligned every word, and draws each hit a frame early.

scenes.title: Lines of skill or chapter code
scenes.say: In lines: nearly fifteen hundred for the full skill, about a hundred for the slim one, nearly five thousand of chapter code.

scenes.text: One shot describes the final run. The rubric, the measured song and the sub-agents were all built before it.

recap: Frames are code, painted from time alone
Brag briefs a framework; slim writes everything
The music video measured every word first
scenes.say: To recap: frames are code. Brag briefs a framework, slim writes it all, and the music video measured its song first.
